baseline.rule: Each regime prepares the public helper against the same isolated frozen synthetic history from which every candidate receives its taskId-to-estimate map. The helper retains its own public tightening/continuation layer logic.

predictionRegimes.expectedEstimateRule: one synthetic completed duration equal to the declared profile nominalWorkMs per task
one fixed cyclic permutation of declared profile nominalWorkMs by canonical task ID; it is deliberately not simulation work

policies.rule: Actual public helper with its own scope layers and frozen history.
Across all global canAdmit candidates, estimate ascending, then admissionPriority descending, then taskId ascending.
Across all global canAdmit candidates, estimate descending, then admissionPriority descending, then taskId ascending.
Across all global canAdmit candidates, static longest path score descending, then admissionPriority descending, then taskId ascending; edges include dependsOn and observes.
At each decision, branch over all public legal select actions and wait when running work exists; use 4096 expansions, safe optimistic lower bound, and a legal CP-greedy incumbent fallback.

bnb.model: all settlements satisfied; graph/state legality from public immutable AdmissionState; no contention slowdown; running remaining is conservatively re-estimated as its full frozen prediction at each observed boundary
bnb.lowerBound: elapsed + max(max currently-running predicted remaining, total unsettled predicted work / graph.root maxParallel)
bnb.completeness: Only a result marked complete is optimal for this hypothetical prediction model, one scenario state and the enumerated select-plus-wait action space. Truncated results are not optimality claims.

cost.timer: performance.now surrounds only a direct synchronous decide loop. The timed public handles are constructed without an observe callback, so no external observer callback runs in the interval. Preparation, synthetic-history materialization, corpus capture and disposal are excluded; prepare elapsed is reported separately.
cost.order: cyclic policy order by sample index

adoptionScreen: After reporting every result, retain the old no-regression per-scenario makespan and secondary metrics plus at least one eligible improvement and p95 <= 1.25x public baseline. This is an unchanged screen, not an experiment filter or automatic adoption authority.
